compute_rationale: Pretraining is throughput-bound; training ~5k steps on 256-seq length on GB10 for demonstration (production would use RTX 5090 for full corpus).
substrate_advantage: From-scratch substrate permits: (1) choosing the exact architecture (here, decoder) to match app demands, (2) training a tokenizer on the corpus (bpe), (3) controlling the data mixture by weight, (4) building the substrate INSIDE a circuit's verified envelope (unlike open-weight, where architecture is frozen). This executor demonstrates lever (4): when installing a compiled circuit, we can build the substrate to match the circuit's vocab and attention pattern, guaranteeing the install succeeds.
